name: Quote generation - PDF clamping regression test
description: Quote for sheets at nominal size (2750x1830) which differs from actual board size (2730x1810). Verifies clamping fix prevents boardsNeeded=0 and grandTotal=0.

messages.text: Hi, I need a quote for 10 sheets of MEL CHIP Value White 16mm please. My name is Clamping Test

expected_behaviors.description: Reply should contain a non-zero quote total
Reply should contain a price starting with R followed by a digit
Quote generation may take up to 30 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: Quote total must not be R0 (clamping bug indicator)
No zero board count or zero total (clamping regression)

notes: Regression test for the PDF clamping fix. If this fails, the optimizer is receiving nominal sizes larger than actual board sizes.
